audit_items.proof_trace: Pre-Fulu epochs skip XOR entirely (L576-577 early return), causing identical fork digests for configs with same fork version but different blob parameters. Additionally, 32-bit XOR truncation enables birthday-bound collisions (~2^16 configs) even post-Fulu.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker runs node with incompatible blob config (e.g., MaxBlobsPerBlock=200 vs honest 100) in pre-Fulu epoch. Fork digest matches honest network despite incompatible params, bypassing P2P compatibility checks (fork.go:57), enabling consensus divergence.
